# A selection dragged past the pane's top scrolls back as it grows. Another
# tab coming forward before the button is let go (its release never reaches
# the pane) stops that, rather than growing the hidden pane's selection on.
type:seq 1 300
key:enter
wait:1.0
drag-select:up
wait:0.3
expect-autoscroll:1
tab:new
wait:0.3
expect-autoscroll:0
